annotation.title_clean: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.title_en: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UAE Ministry of Cabinet Affairs (UAE Legislation portal)
annotation.summary_en: UAE public policy document setting out the country's international stance on AI: active participation in multilateral forums, support for international alliances and rules, six guiding principles (including advancement and collaboration), and aims to be a global AI hub. General AI only; no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: UAE engages in international AI forums that shape future standards and guidelines
Stresses transparency and checkpoints in AI tools so governments can enforce ethical compliance and accountability
Supports international alliances for governing, securing and developing AI
Supports international rules holding nations accountable for AI tools meant to harm or destabilise
Six guiding principles, including Advancement (research centres, funding, compute) and Collaboration
